candidates.description: This vector is related to sequential numbers in the one hundred eighties and nineties.
This vector represents common Hindi characters and syllable fragments.
These tokens represent common Hindi punctuation marks and vowel-sign combinations used for sentence endings.
This vector represents common conjunct consonants, vowel signs, and independent vowels specific to the Devanagari script.
These tokens are Hindi subword fragments and inflectional suffixes frequently appearing in adjectives and nouns.
This vector represents common Hindi demonstrative pronouns and oblique inflected forms based on the root 'इस' (this).
This vector represents characters, consonant-vowel conjuncts, and common word fragments in the Devanagari script.
These tokens represent Devanagari vowel matras and signs combined with punctuation marks, commonly found in Hindi text processing.
This vector represents common Hindi word suffixes, inflectional endings, and character n-grams.
This vector is related to subword tokens, Devanagari script fragments, and Hindi-English transliteration components.
